editions.name: M. Pickthall
editions.author: Mohammed Marmaduke William Pickthall
editions.attribution: Translation: Mohammed Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930, public domain). Served as Quran Foundation resource 19; Quran data provided by Quran Foundation.
editions.choice_rationale: Pickthall (published 1930, author died 1936) is public domain in the US and in life+70 jurisdictions, so the underlying work is redistributable; the copy bundled here is the Quran Foundation-served resource 19, which also keeps one provenance/attribution path with the mandated transliteration (resource 57). Captain decision CD-3 still covers the final edition choice.
